rules.sql: SELECT c.relname, c.relpages, c.relallvisible, round(100.0 * c.relallvisible / nullif(c.relpages, 0), 1) AS pct_all_visible, c.reltuples::bigint AS approx_rows, s.n_live_tup, s.n_dead_tup, s.n_mod_since_analyze, s.last_vacuum, s.last_autovacuum, s.last_analyze, s.last_autoanalyze, pg_size_pretty(pg_relation_size(c.oid)) AS size FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_stat_user_tables s ON s.relid = c.oid WHERE c.relnamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace AND c.relname IN ('cloned_deal_ticket_table', 'security_info_table')

SELECT name, setting, unit FROM pg_settings WHERE name IN ('shared_buffers', 'work_mem', 'effective_cache_size', 'random_page_cost', 'max_parallel_workers_per_gather', 'statement_timeout', 'autovacuum') ORDER BY name
rules.explain: SELECT DISTINCT c.counterparty_parent FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = :bu AND c.lots_to_be_netted <> 0 AND (c.deal_status = 'Live' OR c.deal_status IS NULL)

SELECT DISTINCT c.contract_number FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = :bu AND c.lots_to_be_netted <> 0 AND (c.deal_status = 'Live' OR c.deal_status IS NULL)
